description:
Advances: ancora.review
Ready-for: investigate

Symptom: `mix spec.review --base origin/main~10` on Argos aa8f738f7 (297 changed files) writes a 64,465,082-byte HTML artifact. ancora.review.artifact_size budgets a 200-file fixture under 1 MB.

Evidence (ancora 1.3.1 plus the gate handoff, from the stored gate result):
- 767 findings carry 29.9 MB of message text. Codes: 692 spec/requirement_unverified, 37 derived/unresolved_calls, 36 tags/requirement_untagged, 2 tags/tag_borrowed.
- Nearly all of it is the 37 derived/unresolved_calls messages. The largest, for console.admin, is 4,770,329 bytes: 30,725 comma-separated items (20,352 unique), each naming the call kind, file and line, plus the full test name. Example item: "unqualified at test/argos_web/live/clients/client_environments_test.exs:25 for test/argos_web/live/clients/client_environments_test.exs:458 a retire made while another live environment has an open request and no guardian is refused".
- These are info findings, hidden by spec.check, but review renders each message in full.

Question for investigate: should the finding carry counts plus a bounded sample (and dedupe items), or should review truncate the rendered message? Either way, measure the Argos artifact before and after.
title: derived/unresolved_calls messages make the Argos review artifact 64 MB
